top_signals.title: Trillions Podcast Live From Bloomberg ETFs in Depth: The Big Three
top_signals.summary: Vanguard's Principal & Head of Bank & Institutional Financial Advisor Services Janel Jackson, Anna Paglia, Chief Business Officer at State Street Investment Management, and Elise Terry, Co-Head of Americas, Global Product Solutions & Head of Americas iShares at BlackRock, join Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas and Joel Weber for a recording of the Trillions podcast live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. The leaders of the three largest ETF providers discuss competition and innovation across the industry, the push to expand access to private markets and how AI, tokenization and a new generation of investors could shape the next phase of ETF growth. (Source: Bloomberg)
